title: Podium Larry Alternatives for Service Businesses
seo_title: Podium Larry Alternatives: Compare Options & Fit
description: Compare Off The Clock AI, Sameday AI, Avoca and Housecall Pro CSR AI as alternatives to Podium Larry. Decide what you want to keep before switching.
intro: Compare Off The Clock AI, Sameday AI, Avoca and Housecall Pro CSR AI as alternatives to Podium Larry. Decide what you want to keep before switching.
verdict: Choose Off The Clock when the central requirement is owner-priced job quoting without a full operating-system replacement. Compare Sameday or Avoca for connected front-office workflows. Consider CSR AI when you already intend to run on Housecall Pro.
reason: Replacing Larry and replacing Podium are different projects. Podium’s published home-services package combines Larry with an FSM, while its FSM page describes dispatch, technician estimates and payments. A receptionist-only substitute is not automatically a replacement for that package. [[podium-plans]] [[podium-fsm]]

Write down which parts of the operation you actually want to change. Keep a separate column for tools that should remain: your customer records, job schedule, invoicing and accounting. That makes the shortlist narrower and the eventual demonstration more useful.

Do not base this choice on the claim that Larry cannot give prices. Podium explicitly describes pricing and service-fee handling. The useful question is whether the demonstrated workflow handles your particular measured job, selected extras and exceptions. [[podium-larry]]
choices: When the quote is the missing step

Evaluate the customer’s complete pricing request, not a diagnostic fee alone. Bring a normal project with a separately priced extra and one fact that may need verification. The point is to see whether the business’s rules remain intact from inquiry to next step.
When you want a connected phone operation

Keep this on the shortlist when the phone team, calendar and existing field-service software need to operate together. Demonstrate a returning customer and a changed appointment, not only a new lead with an empty calendar.

Use the demo to follow one call across AI and a human. Check the context the person receives and how the final outcome is recorded. Human escalation should solve an exception, not force the customer to repeat the job.
When Housecall Pro is the system you want
This is an ecosystem choice, not a drop-in Larry replacement. Evaluate the HCP account as a whole before treating its native answering add-on as the reason to migrate.

scenario.title: The test: a service fee is not the entire project
scenario.text: Give every shortlisted provider the same non-emergency project: a measured flooring installation, a separately measured removal area and a selected stair option. Supply your own rules; leave one necessary detail explicitly unknown. This is a buyer-written test, not a claim that any provider has passed it.
checks: Record whether the output prices the requested project, books an estimate visit, or requests review.
Check that the selected stair option remains visible even when it cannot yet be priced.
Confirm where the owner sees the unresolved facts and who is responsible for the next step.

questions: What existing Podium functions would remain, be replaced or need a second vendor?
Does the written offer include the answering product, software access, human handling and usage?
Can the complete conversation and resulting record be exported before a switch?
decision: Start with Off The Clock when job pricing is the reason you are looking beyond Larry. Keep Podium on the shortlist when the broader FSM is itself the desired purchase. A better call outcome should not require an accidental rebuild of the business.
faqs: Yes, Podium describes pricing and service fees. Test whether that covers your actual project rather than assuming all pricing workflows are equivalent. [[podium-larry]]
Is there a public Larry-only price?
The reviewed home-services plan asks for a sales quote. It does not establish a numerical Larry-only rate. [[podium-plans]]
